request.style: English, female smooth jazz vocal, upright bass, brushed drums, piano, saxophone, mellow, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
What shall we say about grace
Should we keep on sinning more
By no means we died to sin
So how can we live in it

[Verse]
Do you not know the truth
We were baptized into Christ
Into His death we went
All of us who followed

[Chorus]
Buried with Him into death
In order that we might rise
As Christ was raised from the dead
We too walk in newness

[Verse]
United in His death
We will be united in life
Our old self was crucified
The body of sin is gone

[Chorus]
Buried with Him into death
In order that we might rise
As Christ was raised from the dead
We too walk in newness

[Bridge]
No longer slaves to sin
Rendered powerless is the body
We have died and are set free
Free from the old life

[Outro]
Walk in newness of life
Raised by the glory of the Father
